method: Predeclared weighted assessor rubric; identity-aware n=1, no statistical significance; source-only limitations explicitly distinguished from reproduced failures.

criteria.evidence: Controlled provider IO exercised original handlers; no live key. Strata search cannot complete import.
criteria.evidence_cn: 受控提供商响应执行原始处理器；无真实 key。Strata 在线搜索后无法完成导入。

criteria.evidence: Readable demo title/synopsis and placeholder posters; real poster download not verified.
criteria.evidence_cn: 演示片名和简介可读，海报为占位图；未验证真实海报下载。

criteria.evidence: Demo director/cast exist; producer missing. Splash online credits empty; Strata import fails.
criteria.evidence_cn: 演示导演、演员存在，均缺制作人；Splash 在线演职员为空，Strata 导入失败。

criteria.evidence: New users, wrong privileges and logout exercised via HTTP; browser login works.
criteria.evidence_cn: HTTP 实测新用户、角色与退出，浏览器登录成功。

criteria.criterion_cn: 服务端身份与独立电影库
criteria.evidence: Role escalation ignored; anonymous library 401, normal admin route 403, separate users.
criteria.evidence_cn: 注册伪造角色无效；匿名电影库 401，普通用户后台 403，各账户独立。

criteria.criterion_cn: 加入看过电影并持久化
criteria.evidence: Both demo libraries persist restart; Strata cannot add provider films because import returns None.
criteria.evidence_cn: 两者演示电影库均跨重启保留；Strata 导入返回 None，无法添加在线影片。

criteria.evidence: Updates and range checks work. Splash permits unwatched scores; Strata nonnumeric score yields 500.
criteria.evidence_cn: 更新和范围校验可用；Splash 允许未看过影片评分，Strata 非数字输入返回 500。

criteria.criterion_cn: 跨用户评论与个人评分展示
criteria.evidence: Cross-user text works and HTML is escaped. Splash includes reviewer score; Strata omits it.
criteria.evidence_cn: 跨用户评论可见且 HTML 转义；Splash 展示评论者评分，Strata 没有展示。

criteria.evidence: 8 and 4, then 10 and 4 produce 7; actual HTTP values match server aggregation.
criteria.evidence_cn: 8 与 4，更新为 10 与 4 后均分为 7，真实 HTTP 值与后端聚合一致。

criteria.evidence: User cannot access admin or delete another user review; admin moderation succeeds.
criteria.evidence_cn: 普通用户无法进入后台或删除他人评论，管理员审核成功。

criteria.criterion_cn: 搜索、详情和电影库全局隐藏
criteria.evidence: Demo paths reject hidden films. Splash provider search leaks hidden row; Strata hidden rating write succeeds.
criteria.evidence_cn: 演示路径均过滤隐藏影片；Splash 在线搜索泄漏隐藏条目，Strata 隐藏后评分写入仍成功。

criteria.criterion_cn: 禁评后保留信息并服务端阻止评论
criteria.evidence: Normal users blocked while detail remains. Splash admin can still comment under lock.
criteria.evidence_cn: 普通用户禁评且详情仍可读；Splash 管理员仍能在锁定时评论。

criteria.evidence: Soft deletion disappears from public detail and remains traceable in admin records.
criteria.evidence_cn: 软删除后公共详情不再显示，后台记录可追溯。

criteria.criterion_cn: 可追查且持久的审计日志
criteria.evidence: Actor/action/time survive restart; Splash action commit and audit insert are separate transactions.
criteria.evidence_cn: 操作者、动作、时间跨重启保留；Splash 业务提交与审计写入分属事务。

criteria.criterion_cn: 数据库跨服务重启保留
criteria.evidence: Verified process restart preserved exact movies/library/log response snapshots.
criteria.evidence_cn: 核验进程归属后重启，电影、电影库和日志响应快照完全一致。

criteria.evidence: Clear dark layouts and working search/detail flow; conventional and visually sparse.
criteria.evidence_cn: 深色层级清楚、搜索详情可用，但视觉常规且留白多。

criteria.evidence: 390px views have no page overflow; tall detail and dense admin tables require scrolling.
criteria.evidence_cn: 390px 无页面溢出；详情较长，后台表格密集，需要滚动。

criteria.criterion_cn: 元数据、加载与错误提示
criteria.evidence: Honest demo banner and visible errors; placeholders and unverified online failure UX limit completeness.
criteria.evidence_cn: 演示标识和错误可见；占位海报、未验证在线失败交互限制完整度。

criteria.evidence: Splash has labelled login and score buttons; both result cards lack keyboard semantics; Strata scores are mouse spans.
criteria.evidence_cn: Splash 登录有标签、评分为按钮；两者搜索卡片缺键盘语义，Strata 评分依赖鼠标 span。

criteria.criterion_cn: 电影库、评论与后台流程
criteria.evidence: Visible controls complete common tasks; basic table moderation rather than refined workflow.
criteria.evidence_cn: 可见控件完成常见流程，审核仍为基础表格操作。

criteria.evidence: Salted PBKDF2, random HttpOnly SameSite cookies and backend roles; no server-enforced session expiry.
criteria.evidence_cn: 有盐 PBKDF2、随机 HttpOnly SameSite cookie、服务端角色；缺服务端会话到期。

criteria.evidence: Cross-user deletion blocked and XSS escaped; Strata accepts demonstrated same-site cross-origin writes.
criteria.evidence_cn: 阻止跨用户删除、XSS 转义；Strata 实测接受同站不同源写入。

criteria.evidence: SQLite parameterization; Strata audit shares transaction, Splash audit can diverge from mutation.
criteria.evidence_cn: SQLite 参数化查询；Strata 审计与业务同事务，Splash 可能产生不一致。

criteria.criterion_cn: 代码可读性与模块结构
criteria.evidence: Small stdlib stacks, readable functions, but large HTTP dispatchers and ad hoc client state.
criteria.evidence_cn: 标准库技术栈、函数可读，但路由分派较大、客户端状态较临时。

criteria.criterion_cn: 有效测试与提供商失败处理
criteria.evidence: Substantial self-tests exist; neither caught important provider path defects.
criteria.evidence_cn: 有较多自测，两者都未捕获重要在线提供商路径缺陷。

criteria.evidence: README launch succeeded unchanged.
criteria.evidence_cn: README 命令原样启动成功。

criteria.evidence: Demo accounts and environment key documented.
criteria.evidence_cn: 演示账户、环境变量 key 已说明。

criteria.evidence: Python stdlib, no install surprises.
criteria.evidence_cn: Python 标准库，无额外安装障碍。

criteria.evidence: Demo is honest, but operational online defects remain undisclosed.
criteria.evidence_cn: 演示数据说明诚实，但在线运行缺陷未披露。

criteria.evidence: Runnable separate repo; many diagnostic screenshots/scripts retained.
criteria.evidence_cn: 独立仓库可运行，但保留较多诊断脚本和截图。

criteria.evidence: Both hold a y=400 platform and support collision; Splash does not render it because meshes only cover the original terrain envelope.
criteria.evidence_cn: 两者 y=400 石台数据与碰撞有效；Splash 仅渲染原地表高度范围，石台不可见。

criteria.evidence: Seeded generation, seed preserved in save, regenerate changes terrain.
criteria.evidence_cn: 种子生成、存档保留种子，重新生成改变地形。

criteria.evidence: Splash sampled 628/3844 wet columns; Strata complete 512² scans of both tested seeds found zero water.
criteria.evidence_cn: Splash 抽样 3844 列中 628 列为水；Strata 两个测试种子各完整扫描 512² 列均无水。

criteria.evidence: Wood/dirt/stone resources, tools and placeable blocks are functional; ore tiers are present.
criteria.evidence_cn: 木材、土石、工具和可放方块可用，存在分级矿物。

criteria.evidence: Real keys move about 5 units; mouse changes yaw; jump and touch UI exercised.
criteria.evidence_cn: 真实键盘移动约 5 格，鼠标改变视角，操作跳跃与触控界面。

criteria.evidence: Walking, slopes, jumping and settling visibly interact with solid terrain.
criteria.evidence_cn: 行走、坡地、跳跃和落地与实体地形发生真实作用。

criteria.evidence: Real hold-mouse mining produces four edits in each initial trial.
criteria.evidence_cn: 首轮均以真实长按鼠标产生 4 处方块修改。

criteria.evidence: Splash directly collects mined dirt/sand; Strata collected two logs after approaching drops.
criteria.evidence_cn: Splash 直接收集土沙；Strata 接近掉落物后取得 2 个木头。

criteria.evidence: UI consumes logs/planks/sticks and produces wooden pickaxe and sword; insufficient recipes disabled.
criteria.evidence_cn: 界面消耗木头、木板、木棍并产出木镐木剑，材料不足的配方禁用。

criteria.evidence: Real attacks damage and kill fixture-positioned enemies; helper use explicitly recorded.
criteria.evidence_cn: 真实攻击可伤害并击杀辅助定位敌人，明确记录辅助条件。

criteria.evidence: Enemies spawn, move and damage player; capped populations observed.
criteria.evidence_cn: 敌人刷新、移动并伤害玩家，观察到数量上限。

criteria.evidence: Contact damage lowers HP; state/HUD and survival controls exist.
criteria.evidence_cn: 接触伤害降低血量，状态、界面和生存操作存在。

criteria.evidence: Clock and rendered rain respond to weather state and continue over time.
criteria.evidence_cn: 时钟与实际雨景响应天气状态并持续变化。

criteria.evidence: Seed/edits/inventory/weather persist; Strata resets enemy HP, Splash silently caps saved edits at 60001.
criteria.evidence_cn: 种子、修改、背包和天气保留；Strata 重置敌人血量，Splash 静默限制存储 60001 处修改。

criteria.evidence: New seed clears edits and inventory in actual new-world test.
criteria.evidence_cn: 真实重开后种子改变，修改和背包清空。

criteria.evidence: Recognizable voxel hills/trees, simple flat materials and limited environmental polish.
criteria.evidence_cn: 方块山林可辨，材质平坦，环境打磨有限。

criteria.evidence: Metal renderer and roughly 60Hz rAF in short active samples; real input works.
criteria.evidence_cn: Metal 渲染，短时活跃采样约 60Hz，真实输入有效。

criteria.evidence: Components work; assisted subtests do not establish an unassisted complete progression run.
criteria.evidence_cn: 组件可用；辅助子测试不代表已无辅助完成整条成长流程。

criteria.evidence: Splash offers water and biome variation but invisible high edits and awkward initial cliff; Strata tested worlds lack water.
criteria.evidence_cn: Splash 有水体与地形变化，但高空修改不可见、首个出生视野被崖壁遮挡；Strata 测试世界无水。

criteria.evidence: Visible touch controls and compact hotbars work; dense labels and basic feedback reduce usability.
criteria.evidence_cn: 有可用触控控件与快捷栏，但文字密集、反馈较基础。

criteria.evidence: Splash streams/evicts chunks; Strata dense 128MiB world plus visible chunk meshes is bounded.
criteria.evidence_cn: Splash 流式加载并淘汰区块；Strata 为有界 128MiB 体素数组加可见区块网格。

criteria.evidence: Small saves work, but edit cap and enemy HP restore defects violate full-state guarantees.
criteria.evidence_cn: 小规模保存可用，但修改上限和敌人血量读档缺陷破坏完整状态保证。

criteria.criterion_cn: 模块、输入与状态可维护性
criteria.evidence: Splash separates world/player/weather/save; Strata concentrates generation, UI and state in main.js.
criteria.evidence_cn: Splash 分离世界、玩家、天气、存档；Strata main.js 集中生成、界面和状态。

criteria.evidence: Menus advance time; bounds exist, but background clamping is not wall-clock catch-up.
criteria.evidence_cn: 菜单内时间继续、有边界限制，但后台 dt 截断不等于真实时间补算。

criteria.evidence: No candidate page errors after observer readiness correction; short active samples near 16.6ms.
criteria.evidence_cn: 修正评测器就绪等待后无候选页面错误，短时活跃采样约 16.6ms。

criteria.evidence: Documented local stdlib servers launch.
criteria.evidence_cn: 文档中的本地标准库服务可启动。

criteria.evidence: Controls and slot documented with real UI.
criteria.evidence_cn: 控制与存档槽均有文档和真实界面。

criteria.evidence: Bundled Three.js and stdlib server.
criteria.evidence_cn: 提供 Three.js 和标准库服务。

criteria.evidence: Browser throttling disclosed; full-save defects and missing water cases not disclosed.
criteria.evidence_cn: 说明浏览器后台节流，但未披露完整保存缺陷或无水情况。

criteria.evidence: Runnable, but numerous debugging scripts/screenshots and environment-specific tests remain.
criteria.evidence_cn: 可运行，但保留大量调试脚本、截图及依赖特定环境的测试。

criteria.criterion_cn: 城郊、河流、城市连续长卷
criteria.evidence: All regions exist, but composition is mostly horizontal bands and broad empty areas.
criteria.evidence_cn: 区域齐全，但构图多为水平条带和大面积空白。

criteria.evidence: Splash adds braces; both bridges lack the original interwoven timber structure and perspective.
criteria.evidence_cn: Splash 有斜撑，但两者均缺原作编木结构与透视。

criteria.evidence: Visible crew/cargo/boats; river is simplified and Strata boats paint above bridge.
criteria.evidence_cn: 可见船员、货物和船只；河道简化，Strata 船只绘制在桥面上方。

criteria.evidence: Moving donkeys/carts/carriers visible, with highly simplified anatomy.
criteria.evidence_cn: 可见移动驴车和挑担者，但形体高度简化。

criteria.evidence: Signs and shop types recognizable; flat repeated facades instead of architectural depth.
criteria.evidence_cn: 招牌与店铺种类可辨，但立面重复、缺建筑纵深。

criteria.criterion_cn: 众多且有差异的人物活动
criteria.evidence: 153 agents versus 230 figures; different props but repetitive stick figures/clusters.
criteria.evidence_cn: 153 个代理与 230 个图形实体，有道具差异，但人物和群组重复。

criteria.criterion: Fine linework, ink and earth palette
criteria.evidence: Muted palette resembles aged silk; clean vector outlines lack original brush/detail richness.
criteria.evidence_cn: 低饱和底色接近旧绢，规整矢量线条缺原作笔触和细节。

criteria.evidence: Front-facing buildings, straight river and scale jumps dominate.
criteria.evidence_cn: 建筑正立面、笔直河道和比例跳变明显。

criteria.evidence: Porters, stalls and boating gestures exist, but few convincing connected narratives.
criteria.evidence_cn: 有挑担、摊贩与操船姿态，缺少可信连贯叙事。

criteria.evidence: An animated schematic town, visibly far from the museum bridge detail and original scroll language.
criteria.evidence_cn: 更像动态示意古镇，与故宫虹桥局部及原作绘画语言距离明显。

criteria.evidence: Clocks advance 3s over 3s; fixed-camera images change; 60s stability passed.
criteria.evidence_cn: 3 秒观察中时钟推进 3 秒，固定相机画面改变，通过 60 秒稳定检查。

criteria.evidence: People follow roads/bridge; repeated groups and overlaps limit natural movement.
criteria.evidence_cn: 人物沿路和桥行走，但重复群组与重叠削弱自然感。

criteria.evidence: Movement exists; Splash depth keys are approximate, Strata always draws boats above static bridge.
criteria.evidence_cn: 运动存在；Splash 深度排序近似，Strata 总在静态桥之后绘船而覆盖桥面。

criteria.evidence: Real drag/wheel/buttons work; Strata visible region presets improve discovery.
criteria.evidence_cn: 真实拖动、滚轮和按钮有效；Strata 可见区域预设更易发现内容。

criteria.criterion_cn: 桌面、手机构图与无障碍
criteria.evidence: No overflow and touch controls work; narrow crops and small controls, no rich canvas alternative text.
criteria.evidence_cn: 无溢出、触控可用，但窄屏裁切明显、控件偏小，缺丰富画布替代文本。

criteria.evidence: Splash separates scene/agents/world/util; Strata is a long monolithic script.
criteria.evidence_cn: Splash 分离场景、代理、世界和工具；Strata 为较长单文件脚本。

criteria.evidence: Time, presets and replay can restore scenes; not a complete persistent animation checkpoint.
criteria.evidence_cn: 时间、预设与重播可恢复场景，但不是完整持久动画检查点。

criteria.evidence: Static caching/culling and short rAF samples near 60Hz.
criteria.evidence_cn: 静态缓存、裁剪与短时 rAF 采样接近 60Hz。

criteria.evidence: Desktop→390px→desktop retained canvas with no page errors.
criteria.evidence_cn: 桌面→390px→桌面保留画布且无页面错误。

criteria.evidence: Independent timed capture completed, no fatal errors.
criteria.evidence_cn: 独立定时截图完成，无致命错误。

criteria.evidence: Documented Python/Node servers work.
criteria.evidence_cn: 文档中的 Python/Node 服务可运行。

criteria.evidence: Controls, state hooks and presets documented.
criteria.evidence_cn: 控制、状态钩子和预设均有说明。

criteria.evidence: Canvas2D with no network asset dependency.
criteria.evidence_cn: Canvas2D，无联网素材依赖。

criteria.evidence: READMEs acknowledge stylization and simplified bridge/faces.
criteria.evidence_cn: README 承认风格化、虹桥和面部简化。

criteria.evidence: Runnable local artifact with test material retained.
criteria.evidence_cn: 本地作品可运行，保留测试资料。
